description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'SpotsViewEdit' which extends 'ViewEdit'. It contains methods related to displaying and formatting module UI elements, such as breadcrumbs and module title, within the SuiteCRM framework. The file includes license headers and security checks typical for a view class in a CRM application.

classes.name: SpotsViewEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing 'Spots' module, extending the core 'ViewEdit' class. Responsible for rendering the edit view UI, including module title and breadcrumbs, with support for localization, theming, and user interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the view by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to invoke the parent display functionality.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML string for the module's breadcrumb and title section, optionally including help links and action buttons, taking into account theme directionality and user preferences.
